Place value and rounding

Place value · Rounding · Error intervals

by Hasan

Thursday

🎯 Today’s objective

By the end of this lesson I can...

✓ I can say what a digit is worth and order numbers, with decimals and negatives

✓ I can round to the nearest 10, 100, 1000 and to decimal places

✓ I can write an error interval and use it to make a decision

So you can read race times, prices and limits the right way!

🏠 Value

The 8 in 3 8 1 6 is worth ?

800 (8 hundreds)

⬅️ Compare

Compare digits from the ?

LEFT (the biggest place first)

0️⃣ Decimals

To compare 0.4 and 0.38, write 0.4 as ?

0.40 (same number of places)

➖ Negatives

Which is smaller: −7 or −3?

−7 (further below 0)

Line up the places. Compare from the left.

🔑 Rounding facts

👀 Decide

Look at the digit ?

to the RIGHT of where you round

⬆️ Up

5, 6, 7, 8, 9: ?

round UP

stays the SAME

5 or more: round up. Keep the place value.
